fichas.title: Garden Enclosures: Walls and Fences
fichas.summary: Overview of garden enclosure design, fence types, materials, installation, and neighbour-boundary responsibilities. Walls and fences act as vertical visual barriers and can define spaces or views. The page illustrates timber, metal, mesh, grille, and hedge enclosures, with details for fixing palings and burying posts. It notes that local regulations govern boundary responsibilities and that, in Berlin, walls and retaining walls generally do not require building permission unless they exceed 2.0 m in height.
uses: Define outdoor spaces and visual domains
